upstream.description: This repository contains the Hugging Face Agents Course.

classification.analysis: The Hugging Face Agents Course is a free, structured curriculum teaching how to build AI agents, delivered as MDX lesson content plus quizzes and a small companion Python quiz-pusher script. It covers agent fundamentals, then hands-on units on smolagents, LlamaIndex, and LangGraph, agentic RAG, fine-tuning for function-calling, observability/evaluation, and a final certified project with a leaderboard. It targets developers and students learning agent frameworks from Hugging Face, with translations maintained by the community.

use_cases.title: Learn how AI agents and LLM tool-calling work from scratch
Compare smolagents, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex agent frameworks
Follow a hands-on unit on fine-tuning an LLM for function calling
Build an agentic RAG use case and get it certified via the final project
